title: The roadmap is generated from open tasks and the handoff checks a task id, not a row edit
body:
Why: AR:58, AR:241; M:proactive-opportunity-scan keeps a ranked list
Outcome: `roadmap.md` is the output of a script over tasks (priority, evidence line); handoff-requests accepts a task id
Proof: `node scripts/claude/roadmap-prune.ts --check` prints in-sync; handoff test. Also `npm run fast` PASS.
Size: 1 PR
After (plan): N19
Source: .krn/runs/overnight/fable-plan.md section 2 (plan id N20).
